description: Reference Gregorian ↔ Hebrew (fixed arithmetic calendar) vectors. Hebrew month numbering: 1 = Nisan … 7 = Tishri … 12 = Adar/Adar I, 13 = Adar II. The Gregorian date is the civil day whose daytime carries the Hebrew date (the Hebrew day began at the previous sunset).
sources: Hebcal (hebcal.com) published holiday dates for 5784–5787 (Rosh Hashana, Yom Kippur, Pesach, Chanukah)
Dershowitz & Reingold, Calendrical Calculations (epoch: 1 Tishri AM 1 = R.D. −1,373,427)
Cross-checked at test time against ICU via Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-u-ca-hebrew') when available (T-CAL-36)

vectors.note: Sabbath #1 (calculated, CONVENTIONAL): 15 Nisan AM 3793, consistent with Nisan 14 = Friday 3 April AD 33 (Humphreys & Waddington 1983)
